events.title: Football Fridays at the Eck — Stanford Weekend
events.summary: Meet fellow Notre Dame alumni and friends at the Eck Visitors Center before the Stanford game. Free and open to the public, with live music, a science exploration program, and conversations with Notre Dame guests. Food and drinks are available for purchase; campus is cashless. This is a community/alumni gathering, not an employer recruiting fair. Individual performances are part of this program, not separate networking events.

events.title: Here Come the Irish Kickoff — Stanford Weekend
events.summary: Kick off your weekend right where the action happens. Grab a bite from the hors d’oeuvres station, hit the bar, and get your cameras ready for epic photos inside Notre Dame Stadium. This is your time to mingle with fellow members, soak in the stadium energy, and enjoy some special surprises and activities. Open to all giving society members at the Green, Blue, and Gold levels, as well as members of the Sorin Founder’s Society, Dean’s Circle, Jesse Harper Council, Athletics Director’s Circle, and Badin Guild. Advance registration is required for giving-society events. This is a donor-community gathering, not an open student recruiting event.
events.location: Foley’s Club at Notre Dame Stadium

events.title: Inspired Leadership Initiative Open House — Stanford Weekend
events.summary: Connect with ILI staff, current fellows, and alumni over refreshments. Free and open to the public; a short presentation starts at 2:15 p.m. The Inspired Leadership Initiative is designed for accomplished individuals who have completed their careers and are exploring their next stage of life. This is a leadership/career-transition open house, not a student internship or employer recruiting fair.

events.title: Rockne Premier Cocktail Hour — Stanford Weekend
events.summary: Soak up the electric energy right inside the most unique spaces of Notre Dame Stadium. This is your chance to grab a drink, talk strategy with Notre Dame coaches, and hang out with special guests from the Athletics Department the night before the big game. Open to Jesse Harper Council and Athletics Director’s Circle members. Advance registration is required for giving-society events. This is a donor-community gathering, not an open student recruiting event.
events.location: Seven on 9 – Corbett Family Hall, Notre Dame Stadium

events.title: Mendoza Rally — Stanford Weekend
events.summary: Connect with Mendoza alumni and current graduate business students in the Mendoza Courtyard ahead of the Stanford game. Complimentary admission, light fare, and an open bar. The organizer asks attendees to focus on connecting with current graduate students. Adults only; Mendoza alumni are asked to bring no more than two guests. This is an alumni/graduate-business gathering, not a general employer recruiting fair.

events.title: Rockne Reception — Stanford Weekend
events.summary: Bring the energy to Club Naimoli for a signature evening packed with great food, drinks, and the ultimate inside track. Connect with fellow Rockne members and hear directly from an exciting lineup of Fighting Irish speakers and special guests. As always, you’ll catch the Notre Dame Volleyball match in absolute comfort, enjoying prime views of the court from our top-tier club space. Please note: The clear bag policy is in effect for this event. Open to Rockne Athletics Fund members at the Irish, Green, Blue and Gold levels. Advance registration is required for giving-society events. This is a donor-community gathering, not an open student recruiting event.

events.title: Shake Down the Thunder Tailgate — Stanford Weekend
events.summary: Experience the ultimate gameday celebration in the heart of student life at Notre Dame’s Duncan Student Center. Join your fellow giving society members for an exclusive, family-friendly tailgate featuring an impressive spread of tailgate favorites, beer and wine, and rotating entertainment from some of Notre Dame’s most beloved traditions — including appearances by the iconic Notre Dame Leprechaun, Notre Dame Cheerleaders, Notre Dame Bagpipe Band, and more. Catch live coverage of afternoon sports on a 22-foot-wide TV screen and multiple TVs throughout the space before heading into the stadium to cheer on the Irish. Please ensure you have your game ticket ready for scanning upon entry , as the venue is located within Notre Dame Stadium and access requires a valid game ticket. Open to all giving society members at the Green, Blue, and Gold levels, as well as members of the Sorin Founder’s Society, Dean’s Circle, Jesse Harper Council, Athletics Director’s Circle, and Badin Guild. Advance registration is required for giving-society events. This is a donor-community gathering, not an open student recruiting event.
events.location: Duncan Student Center at Notre Dame Stadium (Door 16)

events.title: Badin Guild Tailgate — Stanford Weekend
events.summary: Join your fellow Badin Guild members for the ultimate tailgate before the Fighting Irish take on Stanford! Open to all Badin Guild members. Advance registration is required for giving-society events. This is a donor-community gathering, not an open student recruiting event.
events.location: West of South Dining Hall on South Quad
